title: SketchScape GPU worker result
description: The JSON sent in the `result` form field of POST /v1/internal/reconstructions/{job_id}/result (backend/main.py WorkerResult). The request is multipart/form-data: `result` (this JSON), `worker_token`, optional `worker_id` (required when the job was claimed through the lease queue), and file parts `ply` (Gaussian-splat PLY) and `mask` (aligned binary PNG, white is the object) — both required when status is complete — and `preview` (mask-preview PNG). The job id is in the URL path, not in this payload.
